## Business pains
- Automated scrapers, bots, and AI crawlers cause traffic spikes that pollute web analytics. (source: https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGVXIJGG8WG8q4OiPp_Je1EFxynP1oiKsDPElbUJR-_q0lMXmcHMEqTrMPq5lfaRWf1gffQd_EYhU80Avh3diRmxvB8M4YQM13HDbFzTAg1Ne9g35hUn-3Nv6Ji2GMJywmaoniYIIzSCw==) (quote: "Some spikes can come from scrapers, uptime monitors, vulnerability scanners, AI crawlers, spam bots, click farms or automated tools.")
- Multi-site management is cumbersome when users must be invited individually on a per-site basis. (source: https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH3AHJEq0PQWp3eL837aTIi3Qa3W92tk7cqu-HZijwCF2yt_l1tVsv6OauX6oz2Rrh-HSp45SG-vGGDK-k4ANWGhP34Fq7v88pnuN6nDpMyM1D0W0Wuk1Y=) (quote: "Right now you have to invite team members on a per site basis, which is tedious when (in our case) you have hundreds of sites.")
- Plausible faced threats from corporations exploiting its open-source code without contributing back. (source: https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHx_ldVyMh2C7GlbiIfxIOe9CWsJhRWptfcRTQV2Sxi3XOC__8_dPuQADASmYf92nOPIw4VL4j4n547n_oTktZER1R0Ox61j_36jKTUPtR9-FnvcDyhe-S-guCUVR73fMTF) (quote: "In October 2020, we changed from the MIT to the AGPL license to prevent corporations from exploiting our code without giving back.")
- Ingesting high volumes of events led Plausible to reach the limits of vertically scaling cloud servers. (source: https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF-xCWlXBMip0ZwrxZg4MAp1viTr28-bKN6azBE_gsildBGtuWprPRbmOqZsQBR5qIUA_U4tZvY3MsmOjiJyIRtp1NKjm5rVH5cplHEsGbJpQQmPxq8nL2tnMC1YnhcQh9qIhT__9pV) (quote: "We are starting to hit the limits of our current setup where we just scale cloud servers vertically.")
- Hypothesis: Plausible faces increasing pressure to invest engineering resources into automated bot and scraper detection to keep client metrics reliable. (based on: Automated scrapers, bots, and AI crawlers cause traffic spikes that pollute web analytics.)
- Hypothesis: Plausible faces recurring operational tension protecting its open-source intellectual property from commercial exploitation by competitors. (based on: Plausible faced threats from corporations exploiting its open-source code without contributing back.)
- Hypothesis: Plausible requires complex infrastructure re-architecting to scale horizontally as event ingestion expands across high-traffic clients. (based on: Ingesting high volumes of events led Plausible to reach the limits of vertically scaling cloud servers.)
- Hypothesis: Plausible faces friction retaining large agency and enterprise customers whose workflows require centralized multi-site user management. (based on: Multi-site management is cumbersome when users must be invited individually on a per-site basis.)
